column1: # swarm-names.tsv: every SWARM_* name that a file under bin/, hooks/, cmd/ or internal/ names, one row a name.
# The scan skips *_test.go, __pycache__ and *.pyc, and reads every other file whatever its type.
# tests/port_swarm_names_test.sh fails on a name with no row, a row that no file names, and a row whose files differ from the files that name it.
# A port that drops a name deletes its row, so the reviewer sees the name go.
# kind is who sets the name; a name that fits more than one takes the first that fits:
#   setting   a person or CI sets it: README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/ or commands/ offers it, or a brief tells an agent to set it.
#   handoff   swarm-dev sets it for code it runs: a Python helper, a function, another swarm.sh, gh-shim or an agent.
#   internal  no environment sets it: a variable or constant inside the code.
# files lists the files that name it, space-separated, with no line numbers.
